sections.overall: It's hard to think of a stronger double header than the beautifully thoughtful Rebel Heart and Andy Williams Tribute shows. Both rated over 9! Best match of the week was Jon Moxley vs Mike Bailey (8.29). A thrilling Eliminator Match that went just over 18 minutes. What an opener to Collision that was!
sections.mens: No other standout Men's match this week, though various were involved in Multi Man matches, including the Butcher Battle Royal (7.18), which main-evented Collision. As most wrestlers going into this had a rating of around 100, small gains were made for all involved.
sections.womens: The Trios match on Dynamite, which included a heartwarming assist from Rebel, was a highlight of the week (7.48). Britt Baker's first AEW match for nearly two years! The only singles match was a decent showing from Mina Shirakawa vs Queen Aminata (6) on Collision, both of which return to the rankings.
sections.menstag: The Tables Match between The Young Bucks and Fletcher & Knight was the best match from the former in some time, but still didn't beat the '8' barrier (7.81); only a small gain this week. Plenty of other teams featured in Multi Man matches... the Tag Team division is regathering some steam!
sections.womenstag: Hyan & World were the only established team that featured this week. Their match pushing them back to their career best of #2.
sections.trios: More strong Trios matches this week, including New Level & Strickland with their latest defense against Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong, which opened Dynamite (7.38). We had other Trios featured in several other matches this week. Again, great to see the division alive and well!
